item.title: How to Use Testimonials & Reviews to Build Trust
item.description: Testimonials and reviews are an essential component of a successful website. They serve as a form of social proof that can help build trust with potential customers and increase conversions. When someone visits your website, they want to know that your products or services have been tried and tested by others and have received positive feedback. By featuring testimonials and reviews prominently on your website, you can give visitors the confidence they need to make a purchase.
